--- alter_change_stream_set_for_tables_named_schema.sql
ALTER CHANGE STREAM change_stream_name SET FOR sch.table_name1(column1), sch.table_name2
--- AST
&ast.AlterChangeStream{
  Name: &ast.Ident{
    NamePos: 20,
    NameEnd: 38,
    Name:    "change_stream_name",
  },
  ChangeStreamAlteration: &ast.ChangeStreamSetFor{
    Set: 39,
    For: &ast.ChangeStreamForTables{
      For:    43,
      Tables: []*ast.ChangeStreamForTable{
        &ast.ChangeStreamForTable{
          Rparen:    70,
          TableName: &ast.Path{
            Idents: []*ast.Ident{
              &ast.Ident{
                NamePos: 47,
                NameEnd: 50,
                Name:    "sch",
              },
              &ast.Ident{
                NamePos: 51,
                NameEnd: 62,
                Name:    "table_name1",
              },
            },
          },
          Columns: []*ast.Ident{
            &ast.Ident{
              NamePos: 63,
              NameEnd: 70,
              Name:    "column1",
            },
          },
        },
        &ast.ChangeStreamForTable{
          Rparen:    -1,
          TableName: &ast.Path{
            Idents: []*ast.Ident{
              &ast.Ident{
                NamePos: 73,
                NameEnd: 76,
                Name:    "sch",
              },
              &ast.Ident{
                NamePos: 77,
                NameEnd: 88,
                Name:    "table_name2",
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
ALTER CHANGE STREAM change_stream_name SET FOR sch.table_name1(column1), sch.table_name2
